target_customer: Companies with revenue exposed to a single event (airlines, AI and GPU businesses, sports clubs), per the current site
problem: Risks that insurance and futures do not cover leave CFOs exposed to single events. Selfin sources institutional market makers to create event contracts on regulated prediction market venues.
business_model: Brokerage or intermediary fees on event contracts (not stated); the company says it is registering as an introducing broker with the NFA
product_category: Prediction market liquidity and event risk hedging

founders.name: Paula Gutierrez
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists software engineering at startups.

founders.name: Joel Tomas Pimentel
founders.background_notes: From the YC launch post, not a profile section.

technical_complexity.rationale: Matching corporate event exposure to contracts on regulated venues needs market structure and pricing expertise and broker registration, but not novel technology.

defensibility.rationale: Relationships with institutional market makers and a broker registration could matter, but nothing is proven and the venues (Kalshi, Polymarket) can serve institutions directly.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Reports in 2026 describe Kalshi courting institutions and hedgers directly, but nothing found shows an action aimed at Selfin.

market_need_then: The current site points to corporate exposure to single events that insurance and futures miss. 2026 trade press describes corporate hedging with event contracts as emerging but limited by basis risk, liquidity and settlement questions.

identity.logo: Not described in any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and confident with short imperatives such as 'Name the event' and 'Reduce the swing. Raise the multiple.'

branding.brand_signature: Reduce the swing. Raise the multiple.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; a name resembling 'self' and 'fin' suggested a personal finance app and now fits a prediction market broker poorly; older unrelated Selfin social apps exist.

pivots.from: AI bank that connects all of a person's financial products on one platform (YC launch post)
pivots.to: Institutional liquidity and event contracts across prediction markets (current YC page and site)
pivots.why: Not stated in any source found; the date of the change is not public.

outcome_analysis: Selfin is an active Fall 2025 company that appears to have pivoted from an AI personal finance bank to institutional event contracts on prediction markets. Founders have aerospace, quant and consulting backgrounds. Nothing was found on funding, traction or outcomes. The market it chose grew fast in 2026, with Kalshi raising $1B, but Kalshi and others also court institutions directly.
notes: Competitors are left empty because no source dated near the batch described firms doing the same job; sources found were from 2026 and are not competition as of founding. The pivot is inferred from the difference between the YC launch post (AI bank) and the current YC page and site (prediction market liquidity); no source states the change. No funding information was found beyond the YC page link to Crunchbase.
